function: DRL (PPO actor-critic) sets LT transmit beamforming, EV jamming beamforming and TIRS phase shifts to maximize long-term utilities (secrecy rate) in a coalition formation game (pp. 2, 9).
system: Downlink: LT with 4 antennas, 3 single-antenna receivers, 2 passive reflecting TIRSs of 16 elements, full-duplex eavesdropper with 4 antennas; ideal IRS; frequency band not stated (pp. 3, 10).
method: Multi-agent PPO actor-critic with MLP networks (one agent per coalition), offline pretraining then online execution; switch-operation game for coalition selection; reinforcement learning (pp. 9-10).
data_channel: Simulated: distance-based path loss and Rician fading (K-factors 1 and 10), LoS array responses; no 3GPP model, public dataset or measurements (p. 10).
test_conditions: Single setup (Table II) for training and evaluation; training over 3x10^7 rounds (Fig. 4); only the coalition-change cost Cinfo is varied (Fig. 5); no unseen scenario (pp. 10-12).
baselines: AFI-PPO, LFI-PPO (TIRSs always assist EV or LPs), MRT-PPO (MRT beamforming), NBF-PPO (no jamming beamforming), Fixed-PPO (fixed phase shifts); all PPO-based variants (p. 11).
metrics: Cumulative utilities of LPs, EV and TIRSs over time slots; convergence of utilities; number of coalition changes versus Cinfo (pp. 12-13).
complexity: Theorem 3: order of complexity of the whole solution, driven by the PPO network sizes and iteration counts; offline training order also given; no runtime (pp. 9-10).
q1_support: p. 10: "with Rician fading [3], [34], which can be expressed as". Not met: custom simulator with distance-dependent path loss and Rician fading (K-factors 1 and 10); no 3GPP model, ray-tracing dataset or measured data.
q2_support: p. 9: "an offline pretraining stage and an online implementation". Not met: one configuration (Table II, p. 10) is used; Fig. 5 only sweeps the cost Cinfo (p. 12), and no train/test mismatch in channels, antennas or elements is reported.
q3_support: p. 11: "solutions as benchmarks:" AFI-PPO, LFI-PPO, MRT-PPO, NBF-PPO and Fixed-PPO. Not met: each is the proposed PPO solution with the coalition fixed to one side or one party's strategy fixed (p. 11: "are made by PPO-based solution [9]."), so they are variants of the method; no independent earlier learned method or standard DRL baseline.
q4_support: p. 9: "Theorem 3 (Computational Complexity of the Proposed" algorithm): the order of complexity is given on pp. 9-10 and depends on the PPO layer sizes and iteration counts.
q5_support: p. 10: "We conduct simulations on an x64 workstation with Intel" and simulated channels; no code or data link, no public dataset and no measured data anywhere in the paper (pp. 1-15).
notes: Included, area 3: the DRL actors output LT transmit beamforming, EV jamming beamforming and TIRS phase shifts (pp. 2, 9); coalition selection uses switch operations and Shapley-value payoffs, not learning (pp. 6, 8), so the learned part is physical layer. q3 is borderline: AFI-PPO and LFI-PPO cite earlier DRL works [24], [53] but are run as PPO with a static coalition, so they are treated as variants; reviewer to confirm. Fig. 6 calls AFI-PPO 'EFI-PPO' (p. 12). Table II was read from the PDF image (p. 10).
